messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD service: auth.token.validate.rate_spike (severity: P1). error_rate=23% over 5m, 401 spikes across api-prod-us-west. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/abcd/auth-err-5m

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-193847 created and routed to sam (oncall). First notification: 3701234568

sam (oncall): ack'ing. I'm on it, starting runbook: auth/jwt-validation-failure
maria (sre): I'm pulling logs and ingress traces. SLO metrics show token-validate errors up from ~0.2% -> 22% around 05:12 UTC. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, and token-introspect.
jin (eng): seeing elevated 401s in edge-proxy logs: "kid mismatch: expected kid=k1, got kid=k2" across multiple proxies. Pushing to threads: paste logs below:
```
2026-03-15T05:12:34Z proxy[edge-1]: validation failed: jwt: signature verification failed (kid=k2 not found in jwks)
2026-03-15T05:12:38Z proxy[edge-2]: validation failed: jwt: keyid=k2 not present
2026-03-15T05:13:00Z auth-service[signer]: rotated key -> kid=k2 published to signing service metadata, but jwks endpoint returning only kid=k1
```

oliver (auth): I just checked the auth-service deploys. There was a hotfix deploy at 05:09 that rotated the private key and updated the signer, but the JWKS publishing cron job failed to push the new public key to the JWKS bucket. So signers are issuing tokens with kid=k2 but jwks endpoint still serves old key k1.
sam (oncall): That explains mismatch. Mitigation options: 1) roll back signer to k1 (fast) 2) force-publish updated jwks to CDN/bucket (fast if we can auth to GCS) 3) enable verification fallback (NOT ideal). Which can we do quickly?

maria (sre): I can push the JWKS if I get the deploy key. Trying: gsutil cp ./jwks_k2.json gs://prod-jwks/auth/.
jin (eng): I'll standby to restart auth-proxy pods after JWKS update to pick up cache. Command I'll run after confirm: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n prod`

oliver (auth): I can also revert the signer service to the previous image tag (sha:abcdef). Revert command: `fluxctl rollback --resource=Deployment/auth-signer --to-revision=sha:abcdef` — but that might take ~2m for new tokens to propagate. Publishing JWKS is faster.
dave (support): FYI support is seeing customer tickets from a few enterprise accounts. They're hitting 401 on sys-auth calls. Notified top 3 customers.
sam (oncall): Maria, proceed with publishing JWKS_k2 to bucket, then post here. I will coordinate proxy restart. Also escalate to on-call lead if mitigation takes >10m.
maria (sre): done pushing JWKS_k2.json -> `gs://prod-jwks/auth/.well-known/jwks.json` (upload success). CDN purge requested: `curl -X POST https://cdn.redwood.ai/purge -d 'path=/auth/.well-known/jwks.json'` -> 202 accepted.
jin (eng): triggering proxy restart now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n prod`

incident-bot: escalation timer set: 10m. If no recovery, escalate to oncall lead.

sam (oncall): seeing successful key fetch on edge-1: `GET /.well-known/jwks.json -> contains kid=k2`. Edge-proxy logs showing `jwks refresh: new key k2 loaded`
oliver (auth): starting to see token validation slowly recover. 401 rate dropping to 6% over 1m window.
dave (support): notified customers: ACME Corp, NovaApps, and FinPlum. ACME sent a rollback request; told them we're on it and pushing fix.
sam (oncall): note: during outage we temporarily allowed a small grace period for sessions issued in last 10m by accepting tokens with missing kid if they verify via fallback key (we implemented a rate-limited bypass in edge-proxy) — this was controlled and logged.
maria (sre): 401 rate now 1.8% over 5m. Errors mostly internal webhook retries. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/abcd/auth-err-5m shows steady decline.

oncall-handoff-bot: 06:00 UTC handover reminder: sam -> oliver in 8m. Please include incident notes.
sam (oncall): I'm going to start post-incident checklist: annotate timeline, collect logs, capture root cause (JWKS publish race), and schedule postmortem. Short term: add a pre-check after signer deploy to ensure JWKS publishing succeeded and CDN purge completed.
jin (eng): I'll open a PR to add atomic publish + health-check to the deploy pipeline for signer (will include retry/backoff).
oliver (auth): root cause summary: deploy rotated signing key but publishing step failed (auth to bucket expired token). The signer issued tokens referencing new kid before JWKS propagated. Impact: intermittent 401s for ~11 minutes.
dave (support): tallying affected customers -> ~42 tenants had errors, highest impact on enterprise plans with longer sessions. We will reach out with incident update.

maria (sre): closing mitigation: edge proxies refreshed keys, CDN has new JWKS, token validation back to normal. I'm going to keep watch for 30m.
sam (oncall): incident status -> mitigated at 05:23 UTC. Will escalate if regression. Postmortem assigned to oliver + jin + maria.

oliver (auth): action items: 1) add CI gate to signer deploy to verify JWKS publish success (low), 2) rotate keys with overlap window (medium), 3) alert for JWKS and signer key mismatch (low).
sam (oncall): thanks everyone. Closing PD incident after next confirmation that error rate stable <0.5% for 30m. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-193847 acknowledged by sam and resolved by sam at 3701234980

oncall-handoff-bot: sam handed off to oliver at 06:00 UTC — see pinned notes for follow-up tasks.

support-thread: dave to send customer update template and add to status page.

sam (oncall): postmortem owner assigned: oliver. ETA draft in 48h.

maria (sre): leaving trace dumps and log bundle in /var/artifacts/incidents/3701234567 for postmortem.

oliver (auth): final note: verified no tokens issued with kid=k2 prior to 05:09 that would be invalidated; regen logic not triggered. We'll include mitigation timeline in postmortem.

-- end of thread --
